items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $161 from $189 at Morgan Stanley
items.snippet: Morgan Stanley analyst Vincent Andrews lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $161 from $189 and keeps an Equal Weight rating on the shares. Lithium prices have come off this cycle's peak.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares, citing cost efficiencies and capital discipline supporting strong free cash flow.

items.headline: [Materials] Albemarle Rises on Earnings as Global Lithium Demand Grows Faster Than Expected - US Stock Individual
items.snippet: Albemarle is rising after Q2 earnings exceeded expectations for both EPS and sales, with global lithium demand expanding faster than expected, outpacing supply growth.

items.headline: Albemarle Corp: Q2 2026 Earnings Call on Aug 6, 2026 - Transcript
items.snippet: Lithium demand growth continues to outstrip supply growth. As a result, we exited the second quarter near record lows in terms of days of lithium salt inventory. Global stationary storage production has nearly doubled year-over-year.

items.headline: Here's How to Play Albemarle Stock Before Q2 Earnings Release
items.snippet: Falling lithium market prices are weighing on ALB stock, down 16.1% year to date, underperforming the Zacks Chemical - Diversified industry's 17.6% increase and the S&P 500's rise of 9.5%.
